title: Which Naruto character are you? Naruto personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Naruto quiz: answer 12 questions to see whether you are Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, Kakashi, Hinata, Shikamaru, Gaara, Itachi, Rock Lee or Jiraiya. No sign-up.
lede: Never give up like Naruto, think ten moves ahead like Shikamaru, or stay calm and unreadable like Itachi? Answer 12 questions and find your match among ten characters from Naruto.
about: Naruto's ninja are memorable because each one has a clear way of living: Naruto's refusal to give up, Sasuke's pride, Rock Lee's hard work, Shikamaru's lazy genius, Hinata's quiet courage. This quiz looks at your dreams, your habits and how you treat rivals, and scores ten characters.

Your result names the character you match best and shows your scores for the others. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Masashi Kishimoto, Shueisha or Studio Pierrot; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: Who are the main characters in Naruto?
faq.a: Team 7: Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Sakura Haruno and their teacher Kakashi Hatake. Hinata, Shikamaru, Gaara, Rock Lee, Itachi and Jiraiya are among the most popular of the rest.
Only light ones. The questions and results describe each character's personality, not the plot twists.

faq.q: Why isn't my favorite character a result?
faq.a: Ten results keep the quiz short. If you get a close runner-up, that character fits you too.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers are scored in your browser and never saved.

naruto.name: Naruto Uzumaki
naruto.body: Loud, warm and impossible to discourage. You never give up, you never go back on your word, and you win people over by refusing to give up on them either.

sasuke.name: Sasuke Uchiha
sasuke.body: Talented, proud and fiercely independent. You keep your feelings close and go your own way, and once you set a goal nothing pulls you off it.

sakura.name: Sakura Haruno
sakura.body: Smart, hardworking and stronger than people expect. You study, push yourself to keep up with the people you admire and pack a punch when pushed.

kakashi.name: Kakashi Hatake
kakashi.body: Relaxed, perceptive and quietly brilliant. You are always a bit late and hard to rattle, but you never let your team down, because you know what losing people costs.

hinata.name: Hinata Hyuga
hinata.body: Gentle, shy and braver than anyone realizes. You cheer for others quietly, keep growing in your own way and stand firm when it really counts.

shikamaru.name: Shikamaru Nara
shikamaru.body: A lazy genius. You'd rather watch the clouds than work, but when it matters you see ten moves ahead and come up with the plan everyone else follows.

gaara.name: Gaara
gaara.body: Quiet, protective and deeply understanding. You know loneliness from the inside, which is why you look out for others and try to understand people before judging them.

itachi.name: Itachi Uchiha
itachi.body: Calm, gifted and hard to read. You never raise your voice, think several moves ahead and keep your feelings to yourself. People rarely see how much you carry.

lee.name: Rock Lee
lee.body: Hardworking, hot-blooded and sincere. You prove that effort beats talent, train harder than anyone and treat every rival as a reason to improve.

jiraiya.name: Jiraiya
jiraiya.body: Free-spirited, funny and wise. You've seen a lot of the world, you teach through stories and you believe in the next generation more than they believe in themselves.
